convert_vae_checkpoint_to_diffusers: run a python script to convert a VAE.pt checkpoint file to diffusers format and save to output path
convert_safetensors_vae_to_diffusers: run a python script to convert a VAE safetensors checkpoint to diffusers AutoencoderKL format
custom_convert_ldm_vae_checkpoint: convert an LDM VAE checkpoint state dict to a new diffusers-compatible checkpoint dictionary with remapped layer paths
remap_vae_encoder_decoder_layers: remap VAE encoder and decoder layer weights from LDM naming convention to diffusers naming convention
save_vae_as_diffusers_model: load a VAE checkpoint, convert to diffusers config, and save as a pretrained AutoencoderKL model
